title: Customer Lab Orbit — Sprint Planner & Ops Notes
body:
Overview:
This is a compact sprint planner and operational notes doc for the Customer Lab Orbit engagement (internal name: CL-Orbit). Purpose is to collate the week-by-week workplan, explicit handoff checklist, facilitator notes for the kickoff/workshop, and a concise risk + mitigation register. Treat as the single source for day-to-day ops during the first 6 weeks of the trial.

Key goals (customer-facing):
- Validate 90% of high-throughput inference workload on Redwood Dedicated in staging (throughput: 500 reqs/min, 99th p90 latency < 350ms).
- Demonstrate 2x cost reduction vs customer's current baseline via batching + KV cache (target: token/unit cost <= $0.004).
- Integrate customer auth + logging to their SIEM (CloudKMS + S3 audit) for compliance check.
- Complete a live workshop with engineering and product teams and gather 10 prioritized prompts for regression monitoring.

Success criteria (acceptance):
- Preload dataset run (5M tokens) completes w/o model OOM and <1% error rate.
- Canary traffic run at 20% of peak for 48 hours with no P1 incidents.
- Workshop feedback score >= 4.0/5 from attendees and at least 8 action items with owners.

Primary stakeholders:
- Customer lead: Nina Ortega (Customer Product) — escalation contact for product scope.
- Internal AE: Marco Liu — contract and billing point.
- SE lead: Aisha Patel (owner of this doc).
- Infra SRE on-call: Diego Ramirez.
- Security reviewer: Priyanka Rao.

High-level 6-week plan (week boundaries assume project start Monday 2025-11-03):
- Week 0 (pre-work, 2025-10-27 to 2025-10-31):
  - Confirm contracts, get initial access (customer VPN creds, KMS test key), schedule kickoff. Owner: Marco.
  - Provision sandbox Redwood Dedicated pool (2x A100 equiv) in staging region us-west2. Owner: Infra.
  - Collect sample prompt set and representative payload shapes. Owner: Customer + SE.

- Week 1 (onramp + infra validation):
  - Kickoff workshop (90 minutes) — agenda in Workshop section below. Facilitator: Aisha.
  - Deploy model bundle (v1) to staging, run smoke generation across sample prompts (sanity). Owner: Eng-Serving.
  - Baseline perf run (single-threaded) and initial cost estimate. Output: baseline_report.md (attach to Confluence). Owner: Performance.

- Week 2 (integration + monitoring):
  - Instrument token-level tracing, integrate with customer's SIEM, sample alerts. Owner: Observability.
  - Implement KV-prefetch cache for top-50 prefixes. Owner: Serving Runtime.
  - Run 24h soak test at 10% of production traffic shape. Owner: SRE.

- Week 3 (optimization sprint):
  - Apply quantization profile Q2 for non-prod (if acceptable). Owner: Research/Applied ML.
  - Test batching policies across latencies; tune dynamic batching window. Owner: Runtime.
  - Cut canary binary with fallback routing policy to smaller model for heavy tails. Owner: Platform Eng.

- Week 4 (customer workshop + acceptance run):
  - Run live demo workshop with customer engineering, walk through failure modes and fallback. Owner: Solutions Eng.
  - Start 48h canary at 20% of target traffic. Capture metrics and trace samples. Owner: SRE + Observability.

- Week 5 (handoff + knowledge transfer):
  - Finalize runbook, handoff docs, and create ticket list for follow-ups. Owner: SE + Customer Success.
  - Postmortem and lessons learned; update Optimize suggestions. Owner: Product-Optimize.

- Week 6 (buffer and closeout):
  - Address outstanding action items, finalize billing estimate for Dedicated PO. Owner: AE + Finance.
  - Customer feedback survey + executive summary. Owner: Customer Success.

Detailed Task Tracker (short form) — each line: task | owner | est | status | notes
- Configure staging Dedicated pool | Infra | 2d | in_review | ensure GPU image matches runtime-4.1
- Collect sample payloads + secret sharing | Customer + SE | 3d | todo | need sanitized PII removal
- Baseline perf run (latency/cost) | Performance | 2d | todo | JIRA-8247
- Implement KV cache for top prefixes | Runtime | 3d | in_progress | Marco pairing with runtime
- SIEM integration proof-of-concept | Observability | 3d | todo | verify CloudKMS key policy
- Workshop facilitation prep + deck | SE | 1d | todo | short live demo + Q/A
- 48h canary orchestration | SRE | 2d | todo | auto rollback policy ready
- Post-run regression eval | Applied ML | 4d | todo | evaluate prompt set quality drift

Risks & mitigations (concise):
- Risk: GPU OOM in long-context prompts. Likelihood: medium. Impact: high. Mitigation: enforce truncation + dynamic KV eviction; fallback to smaller model. Owner: Runtime.
- Risk: SIEM integration blocked by customer firewall. Likelihood: low->medium. Impact: medium. Mitigation: propose s3 drop + periodic transfer; provide test harness. Owner: Observability.
- Risk: Cost overrun if traffic shape spikes. Likelihood: medium. Impact: high. Mitigation: set hard quota and rate-limiter at edge; notify AE for budget. Owner: Platform Eng + AE.

Workshop: Kickoff + Engineering Deep Dive (90m) — proposed agenda
- 0–10m: Introductions, objectives, success metrics. (Aisha + Marco)
- 10–25m: Customer architecture + constraints walkthrough (customer)
- 25–45m: Live demo — staging model run + tracing example (SE)
- 45–65m: Failure modes & SLOs — how fallbacks work (SRE + Runtime)
- 65–80m: Ops playbook — who does what during an incident (SRE + CS)
- 80–90m: Action items, next steps, schedule follow-ups (wrap)

Workshop facilitator notes / prompts to ask:
- Which prompts are must-pass for product quality? (collect top 10)
- Where is sensitive data written today (S3, DB)? Who owns retention policies?
- Has the customer got an existing incident runbook for third-party infra?
- Any compliance windows or maintenance blackout dates in next 60 days?

Handoff checklist (minimum):
- Runbook.md with rollback steps and contact list (SRE, SE, AE, Customer)
- Completed baseline_report.md and canary_results.csv attached to Confluence page
- Prompts & regression set uploaded to repo and linked (GH PR 52)
- Billing estimate and Reserved capacity proposal drafted and reviewed by AE
- Security review signoff (Priyanka) or outstanding items enumerated

Escalation contacts (ordered):
- P1 — Diego Ramirez (SRE on-call): diego@redwood.ai
- P2 — Aisha Patel (SE lead): aisha@redwood.ai
- Billing urgent — Marco Liu: marco@redwood.ai

Open questions / TODOs (short):
- Customer to confirm peak token/sec profile by 2025-11-05.
- Need IAM read-only test account; customer to send by 2025-10-30.
- Decide whether to enable quantization in prod (defer until perf + quality eval complete).

Appendix: quick run commands and notes (ops snippets)
- Canary start (internal): redwoodctl canary start --env staging --model bundle:v1 --traffic 20% --duration 48h --rollback-on P1
- Perf capture: perf-capture --target staging --prompts ./sample_prompts.json --out baseline_report.json
- Observability: add trace header X-Trace-Client: CL-ORBIT for workshop sample traces

Notes to self (SE): keep the kickoff tight, surface costs early, and lock the regression prompt list in the first week. Expect 2x iteration on batching windows.

Last edits: 2026-02-15 — consolidated week boundaries, added SIEM fallback option, clarified acceptance criteria.
